## ⚡ CHAMPION
**Kennen**

**Skin Replacement:** Base Skin

---

## ✨ Unique Features

**Toggle Emote (Ctrl + 5)**  
Pikachu will wear **Ash’s hat**, and a Pokémon-themed track will play.  
*(Music can be toggled off through the scoreboard.)*

**Spawn Music**  
At the start of each game, **one of 20 tracks from Pokémon: Let’s Go!** will play and continue throughout the match.  
You can switch back to League’s default BGM using the **Tab key**.

There is also a **1% chance to spawn as a Shiny variant** at the start of each game.
